settings.text:
From the alchemy of the dye lab to the sculptor's final cut.

A Corvo rug is made in four stages: yarn, tufting, structure and the final touch.

settings.title: The people
Yarn
settings.text: True luxury requires exactitude. In our dedicated colour laboratory, we don't just select hues; we engineer them. Every batch of yarn undergoes rigorous in-house testing for colour fastness and consistency, ensuring that the vibrant tone you see today remains just as rich for generations to come.
settings.image_alt: A technician in a white coat and gloves draws red dye with a pipette in the colour laboratory
settings.image_2_alt: Cones of yarn dyed deep blue, stacked on the spindles of a dyeing machine

settings.title: Tufting
settings.text: Our tufting process represents the evolution of Portuguese heritage. We utilize a hybrid technique where mechanical precision meets human intuition. The tufting tool allows for deep, plush pile heights that anchor the rug, while our artisans manually refine the pattern row by row. It is deliberate, high-velocity craftsmanship that results in a rug of uncompromising durability and touch.
settings.image_alt: A tufting head works across a white canvas marked with the lines of a design
settings.image_2_alt: A hand-held tufting gun adds yarn to a rug in blue, yellow and white

settings.title: Structure
settings.text: Beauty requires strength. Once tufted, the rug's reverse is secured with a natural latex compound. This invisible step locks the fibres in place, ensuring the pile remains dense and upright for decades. It provides the necessary weight to anchor the rug to your floor, marrying flexibility with permanence.
settings.image_alt: A craftsman in a mask spreads latex with a trowel over the back of a rug stretched on its frame

settings.title: The final touch
settings.text: True luxury creates no noise. In this final stage, we meticulously inspect every square inch of the pile. Artisans hand-trim any irregularities and define the pattern's edges with scissors. It is a slow, quiet process that guarantees the texture underfoot is perfectly smooth and the design lines are razor-sharp.
settings.image_alt: A craftsman seen from behind trims by hand a rug with wavy brown and cream stripes, hung on the wall
